Aha: middleware only checks “cookie exists”, while the client `AuthGate` checks “token is actually valid” via `api.auth.me`. If your cookie is present-but-expired, `/cms` will briefly render, then `AuthGate` will redirect—this often looks like a “refresh”. Next I’ll inspect the login flow to confirm whether it’s bouncing (and then I’ll adjust middleware to validate/clear bad tokens earlier so `/cms` doesn’t flash + reload).
